notes.title: Food drop change
notes.content: - Food will no longer drop if the player already has too much (50 or more)

notes.title: minor bug fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] fixed a bug where the shiny star icon for a collected shiny did not illuminate in the Codex, while the respective shiny was benched.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Inventroy QoL Changes
notes.content:
[h2]Inventory Changes[/h2]
- Added 'Store All' buttons to the inventory menu for storing all food items and evo items in the world, with one click.
- Capped the maximum number of storable food items to 50
